description.value: Megabite Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain with a Port Coquitlam location in the Mary Hill area, offering a broad menu of meat, chicken, and veggie pizzas alongside sides and beverages. The store supports both in-store pickup and delivery with full online ordering. Touring cyclists can order ahead for a quick, filling stop on routes through the Coquitlam corridor.

address.value: 102-2540 Mary Hill Road, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C3B2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Port Coquitlam store confirms the address (102-2540 Mary Hill Rd, V3C3B2), provides a phone number absent from OSM, and shows an active menu with delivery and pickup options — confirming the location is open. The menu includes a dedicated Veggie Pizzas section supporting a vegetarian amenity claim. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
